parts.text: {"translations": [{"id": "t1", "english": "How do you make these colours?", "alreadyEnglish": false}, {"id": "t2", "english": "We mix clay and gum for dabu (mud-resist printing).", "alreadyEnglish": false}, {"id": "t3", "english": "And how long does it dry?", "alreadyEnglish": true}, {"id": "t4", "english": "Two days, 2 days in the sun.", "alreadyEnglish": false}, {"id": "t99", "english": "A turn that does not exist.", "alreadyEnglish": false}], "primaryLanguage": "hi", "summary": ["Giriraj explains how the dabu resist paste is made from clay and gum.", "It dries for 2 days in the sun."], "quotes": [{"id": "t2", "original": "मिट्टी और गोंद", "english": "clay and gum"}, {"id": "t4", "original": "हम नील से रंगते हैं", "english": "We dye with indigo"}], "terms": [{"term": "dabu", "gloss": "mud-resist printing"}, {"term": "ajrakh", "gloss": "never said"}]}
